prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop website direction comp
Primary request: Create a 16:10 full-fidelity first viewport for Avancini OS in the approved “Atlas Vivo” visual world, testing a map-led composition while staying commercially clear and premium.
Scene/backdrop: warm mineral paper with subtle fiber, sparse black editorial rules and one cobalt route that becomes the main visual gesture.
Subject: compact header: AVANCINI OS left, PROJETOS / VERTENTES / MÉTODO / CONTATO centered, MENU right. A monumental headline occupies the upper-left and center: “Uma direção. Muitas formas de fazer avançar.” A cobalt route begins inside the word DIREÇÃO, travels across the viewport through the exact nodes SITES, COMÉRCIO, IDENTIDADE, AUTOMAÇÃO, IA, SISTEMAS, then opens into one large horizontal project photograph labeled “CLÍNICA SAN DIEGO — PROJETO REAL”. Supporting sentence: “Estratégia, design e tecnologia trabalhando como um só sistema.” Small action: “EXPLORAR A AVANCINI”.
Style/medium: premium Brazilian editorial design studio, atlas and field-guide discipline, distinctive high-contrast serif plus precise grotesk.
Composition/framing: one dominant typographic statement and one continuous map gesture; generous negative space; project image as proof, not decoration; no card grid, no split SaaS hero, no repeated pills.
Color palette: paper #eeeae0, ink #151515, cobalt #3157ff, signal lime #e8ff3d used only as a tiny destination marker.
Text (verbatim): “AVANCINI OS”; “PROJETOS”; “VERTENTES”; “MÉTODO”; “CONTATO”; “MENU”; “Uma direção. Muitas formas de fazer avançar.”; “SITES”; “COMÉRCIO”; “IDENTIDADE”; “AUTOMAÇÃO”; “IA”; “SISTEMAS”; “CLÍNICA SAN DIEGO — PROJETO REAL”; “Estratégia, design e tecnologia trabalhando como um só sistema.”; “EXPLORAR A AVANCINI”.
Constraints: exact legible Portuguese, no fake metrics, no testimonials, no fictional logos, no dashboard, no green neon, no excessive decorative coordinates, premium and highly original.
